label: Market Close
headline: S&P -3.7%, 7th straight loss, Nasdaq -5.3%, SOX -10.7%, 10y -14bp, Zscaler +17% after hours
stance: Chips led a 7th straight S&P 500 loss and put the S&P and Dow in correction. Treasuries rallied even after Cook called for tighter policy.

scorecard.call: Morning: S&P 500 down 6 straight, Nasdaq futures lower again.
scorecard.actual: Seventh straight loss. S&P -3.7%, Nasdaq -5.3% at the close; S&P and Dow in correction (4:23pm ET).

scorecard.call: Midday: Treasuries rallied and Brent fell at 11:30.
scorecard.actual: 10y 4.91%, -14bp at the close, extending the -8.6bp at 11:18. Brent $89.87, -2.3%, vs -3.8% at 11:23.

scorecard.call: Midday: a lower close would make 7 straight down sessions.
scorecard.actual: Right. S&P 500 closed 6,910, down 7 sessions in a row.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Fed's Cook said policy is not restrictive enough (12:21pm ET). Treasuries rallied anyway: 30y -10bp at the close.
Gold $3,539, -4.0% at the close. Gold and silver posted their worst week in 8 months (5:50pm ET).
Trump threatened a large tax on US firms building data centers abroad (3:47pm ET).

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Nasdaq erased its 2026 gain Friday. Nasdaq 100 -10.4% on the week, worst since March 2020 (5:03pm ET).
Chip stocks lost $2.3tn of value this week (5:44pm ET). Large bearish options bets placed on chips Friday (2:33pm ET).
Russell 2000 -2.8% at the close, a smaller loss than the Nasdaq.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: LQD +0.6%, HYG -0.3% at the close. Investment grade gained with Treasuries; high yield fell with stocks.

items.head: Nvidia -14% at the close on SEC probe report
items.body: Shares fell after a report of an SEC probe into possible accounting issues (2:59pm ET). Longest weekly losing run since 2008.

items.head: Anthropic -8.5%, closes $88.91
items.body: Second session after its $83 IPO. Shares stayed above the offer price (4:25pm ET).

items.head: Zscaler +16.7% after hours on takeover report
items.body: Report says CrowdStrike is in talks to buy it (4:35pm ET). Zscaler +16.7% at 6:42pm; CrowdStrike -4.3% at 6:41pm.

watch.head: Iran strike decision
watch.body: Trump is weighing renewed strikes on Iran as the military warns of strain (3:42pm ET).

watch.body: Factory, mining and utility output plus capacity use.
